## Planned measures

- PNC source-record volume by date and facility
- PNC visit counts and KF1–KF4 coverage
- First and latest PNC dates
- Pregnancy and delivery linkage completeness
- SIGIZI `KOHORT_NIFAS` and EPUS PNC source availability

## Analytical rule

SIGIZI PNC details require a curated adapter with an explicit visit date and
grain. The public website will not extract clinical fields from source JSON.
